up: For all single-protein targets in the database, retrieve the target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence. Return exactly target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.target_type, cs.accession AS protein_accession, cs.sequence AS protein_sequence FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_components tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN component_sequences cs ON tc.component_id = cs.component_id WHERE td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN';
